title: About us
paragraphs: Degusto is a public catering organization.
Degusto Food Studio provides catering services. Its founder is Sargis Gasparyan. Organizing public catering is one of the most demanding service fields and requires consistent work.
The company has been operating for about four years. It offers customers a wide range of dishes and also provides delivery.
heroImageAlt: Degusto Restaurant neon sign on a green living wall
missionBody: Our mission is to ease everyday kitchen burdens, create a warm atmosphere, and serve quality food. Care for every customer. The company is built on three principles: cleanliness, freshness, and affordability.
goalParagraphs: One of our goals is to build a brand known across Armenia and accessible to every community, age, and gender — with a strong, organized, united team.
Ensure and continually improve high service quality with a personal approach to every customer.
